## Type of change

## Before merging — check on the Vercel preview

**Automated (CI runs these for you):**
- [ ] Frontend CI passed (lint + build are green)

**Manual — click through the preview URL:**
- [ ] App loads and I can **log in**
- [ ] **Make a sale** flow works (staff: add to draft → Save Order)
- [ ] **Draft order**: add an item, remove it, clear — removed items stay gone
- [ ] **Approve / view** a pending sale (owner/admin) works
- [ ] Checked on a **real phone / narrow screen** (layout not broken, buttons tappable)
- [ ] **Dark and light** modes both look right
- [ ] No console errors in the browser
